name: list_shortcuts
summary: List the Shortcuts the user has on this Mac, with each shortcut's name and unique identifier, as `shortcuts list --show-identifiers` reports them. Use for 'what shortcuts do I have / show my shortcuts' and to find the exact name before running one. Read-only; only enumerates shortcuts and runs none of them.

name: run_shortcut
summary: Run one of the user's Shortcuts by name (via `shortcuts run`). This is the sanctioned way to trigger automations that have no dedicated CLI — Focus/Do-Not-Disturb modes, HomeKit scenes, and any user-authored flow. A shortcut is arbitrary automation authored outside this server, so its effect is unbounded and there is NO undo: the operation is HIGH risk and always STAGED for explicit human confirmation. Staging first checks the named shortcut actually exists and names it verbatim in the preview.

params.name: name
params.description: The exact name of the shortcut to run (as shown by list_shortcuts). Must not begin with '-'.

params.name: input
params.description: Optional path to an existing file to pass to the shortcut as its input. Must exist and must not begin with '-' (use ./).
